SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, R.USERNAME TRUSTORNAME, E.USERNAME TRUSTEENAME FROM T_CORE_ATTORNEY A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER R ON A.TRUSTOR = R.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER E ON A.TRUSTEE = E.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
